observations.title: Ask another player for teleport consent
observations.player_action: Use tpa to request going to a player or tpahere to request their arrival; the recipient uses tpaccept.
observations.outcome: Only the accepted request performs the configured teleport flow.
conditions: Request expiry, limits and teleport conditions come from installed server configuration.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Use the native accepted/completed teleport state, not request-sent chat. The installed artifact is WereF0X's 2.0.0 mod, not the unrelated 1.20.2 macro datapack named TPA.

observations.title: Cancel or block incoming requests
observations.player_action: Use tpacancel for the outgoing request or tpatoggle to control receipt.
observations.outcome: Requests can be withdrawn or refused automatically rather than forcing another player to move.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.

observations.title: Return to an eligible previous position
observations.player_action: Use back when the server has recorded an eligible previous position.
observations.outcome: The mod records configurable return locations after teleport/death, subject to server rules.
conditions: JEM event safe-exit/death-elimination policy remains canonical and is not replaced by upstream back semantics.
